notes: SUM: POC paused / deal effectively closed-lost due to sponsor exit and right-now priority shift after Q4 reorg.
Background: Hawthorn is a mid-market telecom vendor building an on-edge conversational assistant + reranking for routing customer trouble tickets to the right engineering team.

Initial interest: high — wanted predictable latency (p95 <= 75ms on edge), throughput ~30 rps per site, strong cost controls. Preferred model family: quantized LLMs, fine-tune for company taxonomy. Asked about private deployment (on-prem & VPC) and KMS integration.
Timeline:
- 2024-09-12: Intro call (AE Maya) — discovery; infrastructure team engaged, very security-focused.
- 2024-10-03: Technical deep-dive (SE Derek) — outlined Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs; Derek demoed autoscaling and KV-prefix caching; doc link shared (drive:/deals/hawthorn/POC-scope-v3.pdf).
- 2024-10-17: Security questionnaire submitted (SOC2 + KMS follow-ups). Security team requested retention controls and audit log sample (shared).
- 2024-11-04: 2-week POC kickoff scheduled (scope: 15-day inference latency baseline + reranking evaluation on 20k queries). AE and SE aligned on success metrics.
- 2024-11-18: Sponsor (VP Product — Raj Malhotra) informed team of incoming reorg; asked to pause external procurements until leadership confirmed. POC put on hold.
- 2024-12-02: Follow-up — Raj accepted offer from competitor (MajorCloudAI) to run an in-house POC; internal champion bandwidth decreased. SE still available for technical Qs but procurement frozen.
- 2025-02-14: Attempted re-engagement (Maya) after org chart update; new head of platform replaced Raj, priorities shifted to 5G network core projects. No commitment to re-open POC.
- 2025-07-14: Final review call (ff_2025-07-14_hawthorn_poc_review) — engineering team appreciative of Redwood docs but said procurement is deprioritized for the next 6-9 months.

Current status: Stalled/closed-lost for now. Primary reason: no internal champion after sponsor left for competitor; secondary: budget reallocation and company reorg. Security blockers were mitigated technically (SOC2 evidence, KMS plan) but timing killed momentum.
Quotes: 'We love the latency numbers but we can't make this a priority until the network core project is stable' — new Head of Platform (paraphrase).
POC artifacts: scope doc, test dataset (sensitive redacted), security FAQ shared. Jira ticket INF-7321 logged for follow-ups (retention question).
Next actions (recommended):
- Mark as closed-lost in CRM (reason: no_internal_champion) and set a 6-month cadence to check back.
- Keep security artifacts in deal folder; offer 'on-ramp' template for when budget re-opens.
- Winback play: targeted note to new Head of Platform highlighting Autonomous fallback + cost controls; include recent benchmark vs MajorCloudAI if available.

Internal notes / AE playbook: consider low-effort touchpoints (quarterly), do not escalate to CSM until champion re-emerges. Record competitor signals: MajorCloudAI ran a limited in-house POC; follow for signs of failure.
